note: CD4Tcells: helper T cells — dense blob at the lower-right (CD4+, CD8-). CD8Tcells: cytotoxic T cells — dense blob at the upper-left (CD4-, CD8+). Both CD4 and CD8 are bimodal — quadrant boundaries set at the valley between the positive and negative peaks of each axis. DPT (upper-right) and DNT (lower-left) subsets are not categorized and fall into Unassigned.
tips: CD4Tcells: CD4+ CD8-. CD8Tcells: CD4- CD8+. DPT and DNT (includes MAIT/NKT) subsets fall outside both polygon regions and are not tracked. Useful co-markers: CD45RA_Er166Di / CCR7_Yb171Di enable memory subset analysis (Naive/TCM/TEM/TEMRA) — present in panel but not gated in this simplified workflow. FoxP3_Er167Di (in panel) would resolve Treg within CD4Tcells; CD161_Er168Di (in panel) would mark MAIT within the unassigned DNT residual; CD7_Pr141Di confirms T cell identity across both CD4 and CD8 subsets (expressed on >95% of mature T cells); CD56_Lu175Di (in panel) would identify NKT within DPT/DNT residuals.
